releaseNotes:
Authentication, sync performance, and reporting stability update.
- Improved authentication and session handling, including Logout and Switch User
- Prevented Live Sync writes without a current authenticated session
- Optimized incoming synchronization database lookups
- Added the Room 27-to-28 Pricing Logs index migration
- Reduced memory use during daily JSON report generation
- Added Owner-only business-session diagnostics
- Preserved existing PSA/TAG/CGC and pricing integrations
Known issue: cold offline startup may still fail and requires follow-up.
